name: World Cup live status object fix
purpose: Fixes inline World Cup cards that showed 'لم تبدأ' even when match status is stored as an object with key/state live or live_phase=live.
safe_scope: Only changes World Cup status parsing/rendering in the inline cards. It does not change card design, colors, teams, match order, numbers, or update workflow.
expected_result: A live match with score/current/live_phase/status object now displays الحالة: مباشر instead of لم تبدأ.
